network.tdhHistoric.provenance: Schedules 1.1 to 1.3 are as 6529.io published them on its TDH pages; 1.4 is the backend’s current rule file, which P26 cites line by line, and tdh-v1.0’s registry holds its values. Only 1.4 is checked: by the replay of the October 11, 2026 cycle, and daily since October 14, when the daily comparison began. Live snapshots before November 14, 2024 were often taken hours before midnight, so those days could not be reproduced in any case (DEV-3).
network.tdhHistoric.provenance.archive: Schedules 1.1 to 1.3: the historic boosts page’s source at commit 2d92c95 (October 9, 2025)
network.tdhHistoric.provenance.rules: Schedule 1.4: the backend’s rule file at d0c070c, the commit P26 cites
network.tdhHistoric.current.rules: Schedule 1.4 pays +0.05 for each complete season of seasons 1 to 20, except the current one; without the whole of Season 1, Memes 1 to 3 (Genesis) add +0.01 and Meme 4 (Nakamoto) +0.01. A full set pays every boostable season’s bonus at once, and each further full set a smaller extra bonus. Each Gradient adds +0.02, up to 5. TDH-v1 restates this schedule exactly.
